questions.text: How would you design a training pipeline that needs to retrain a model automatically as new data arrives?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Scheduled/triggered retraining, data validation, versioning, automated evaluation gates before deploy.

questions.text: Walk me through how you'd serve a model in production and handle a sudden 10x traffic spike.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Autoscaling, batching, model quantization/distillation, caching, load shedding.

questions.text: How do you detect and respond to model drift in production?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Monitoring input/output distributions, shadow deployments, alerting thresholds, retraining triggers.

questions.text: Explain the tradeoffs between batch inference and real-time inference for a recommendation system.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Latency vs freshness vs cost, precomputation, hybrid approaches.

questions.text: How would you version datasets and models so an experiment is fully reproducible?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Data/model registries, experiment tracking (e.g. MLflow), pinned dependencies and seeds.

questions.text: Tell me about a time a model performed well offline but failed in production. What happened?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Root-cause (train/serve skew, leakage), diagnosis process, fix and prevention.

questions.text: Describe a time you had to balance model accuracy against latency or cost constraints.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Tradeoff reasoning, stakeholder alignment, measurable outcome.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you worked closely with data scientists to productionize a model.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Collaboration style, translating research code into production-grade systems.

questions.text: Describe an incident where a production ML system broke. How did you respond?
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Incident response, rollback strategy, postmortem, follow-up safeguards.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you pushed back on shipping a model that wasn't ready.
questions.ideal_answer_notes: Judgment under pressure, communicating risk clearly, outcome.
